entities.summary: Apollyon is a black metal/thrash metal multi-instrumentalist, formerly associated with Dødheimsgard, Cadaver and Immortal, now playing in Aura Noir. He has done guest vocals on the Darkthrone albums Plaguewielder and Sardonic Wrath, and also on Audiopain's EP 1986 (2000). He was a live guitarist for Gorgoroth from 2003 to 2004, and performed at Gorgoroth's infamous Kraków show in February 2004 and later released on the video album Black Mass Krakow 2004. Ole Moe was a composers & musicians from Norway (b. 1974-04-01, Norway). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a multi-instrumentalist and composer in the black metal scene, Ole Moe's work with bands like Dødheimsgard, Cadaver, and Immortal contributed to the genre's development and influenced subsequent artists. His guest vocals on Darkthrone albums have also had a lasting impact on the Norwegian black metal scene.
